title: A Shark Was Caught 700 Miles Up the Mississippi River

scenes.text: A shark was caught 700 miles up the Mississippi River.
Bull sharks can swim far up rivers, even in fresh water.
In 1937, one was caught at Alton, Illinois, about 700 miles from the ocean.
Another turned up near St. Louis in 1995.
Pound for pound, its bite is the strongest of any shark studied.
So yes, there are sharks in the Mississippi.
